meta.name: lifecycle-messaging
meta.description: Designs automated email and SMS programs — welcome and onboarding sequences, nurture, re-engagement, transactional messaging, and the timing and segmentation behind them. Use this to build or fix an email sequence, plan lifecycle automation, improve open or click performance, set up SMS flows, or decide what messages a customer should receive and when.

copy.tagline: 设计自动化邮件与短信的客户旅程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在运营客户邮件或短信,想把触达时机和内容自动化。
copy.tagline_en: Design automated email and SMS customer journeys.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage customer email or SMS and want to automate timing and content.

howto.what: Claude 会按用户生命周期阶段（新注册、激活、习惯、风险、流失）设计邮件/SMS序列，提供内容、时机、频率建议，并诊断打开/点击/退订问题，确保短信合规。
howto.when: 当用户要求设计或优化邮件/SMS序列、规划生命周期自动化、改善打开率/点击率等指标时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个新用户欢迎邮件序列
say.note: Claude 会按三个阶段给出内容建议。

say.text: 我的邮件打开率很低，帮我诊断原因
say.note: Claude 会先查交付问题，再看文案。

say.text: 给客户设置订单发货的短信通知
say.note: Claude 会提示短信合规和发送时间。

howto.what_en: Claude will design email/SMS sequences based on lifecycle stages (new signup, activated, habitual, at risk, lapsed), offering content, timing, and frequency advice, and diagnose open/click/unsubscribe issues while ensuring SMS compliance.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users ask to design or optimize email/SMS sequences, plan lifecycle automation, or improve metrics like open/click rates.

say_en.text: Design a welcome email sequence for new users.
My email open rate is low; help diagnose.
Set up order shipping SMS notifications.
